summary: Galmed Pharmaceuticals Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing a Share Purchase Agreement to acquire all outstanding share capital of Colospan Ltd., an Israeli medical device company. The transaction was entered into on June 8, 2026, with shareholders holding >92% of Colospan's voting power agreeing to sell. No price per share, implied value, or premium were disclosed. Closing is expected in Q2 2026. The board's recommendation is not specified, and no advisors are named. This is a foreign private issuer report (Israeli companies); analogous to a U.S. merger agreement announcement. Watch for regulatory approvals in Israel and potential minority shareholder squeeze-out mechanics given the high consent threshold.
